Solution 06

Automation and Packaging Solutions

Central PLC control and single-station flour packaging.

Request a QuoteContact Our Team

01Overview

What this solution covers.

A central PLC panel controls every machine in the line, with alarms and motor protection. At the end of the line, a weighing and bagging machine packs flour in 25–50 kg units.

Application areas

  • Line-wide machine control
  • Bagging of finished flour
  • Control upgrades for existing equipment

02Process information

How the process runs.

  1. 01

    Control

    One panel sends commands to all machines; wiring runs in channels.

  2. 02

    Protection

    Power is cut automatically on a supply change, and failures raise an alarm.

  3. 03

    Packing

    Flour is weighed and bagged at a single station.
